severity_reason: Test tolerance issue on a loaded host; the profiler itself is correct.

title: Inspector test left pointer lock set, breaking later drag checks
status: Fixed in v0.0.32 (9c3320a): the drag check clears pointer lock first; a browser run passes all 16 milestones.
severity_reason: An earlier test left pointer lock set, so a later drag check misbehaved.

title: The menu logo has a line above the name and reddish-pink letters instead of gold
status: Fixed in v0.0.33 (97b0a98): name-only logo on the palette's gold ramp, no rule above; tests/test_menu_logo.py; FS-UAE Options menu checked.
severity_reason: Cosmetic: the menu logo shows a rule above the name and reddish letters instead of gold.

title: Open-world terrain maps spend about a fifth of their bytes on visibility data that culls little
status: 16 October 2026: Closed: superseded by CHIM shared terrain (no vis lump); legacy region maps retire as the CHIMport proceeds.
severity_reason: About 21 percent of open-world map bytes (0.77 GB) are visibility data that culls little.

title: Neighbouring canton bodies end at the Arena frame edge, in view
status: 16 October 2026: Closed: superseded by whole-city Vivec in one CHIM frame (default since v0.0.36); the Arena-only frame is a legacy option.
where: Vivec Arena preview, canton bodies cut at the frame edge
severity_reason: Design limit of the one-frame preview: canton bodies end in a straight cut that is in view.

title: The Arena frame's handoff area reaches into neighbouring cantons; its frame edge can be in view
status: 16 October 2026: Closed: superseded by whole-city Vivec in one CHIM frame (default since v0.0.36).
where: Arena frame handoff core (config/vivec_arena.json), Redoran east exit
severity_reason: Handoff arrives about 205 units from the frame edge, so the edge is in view.

title: dbg tp vivec_arena leaves the player at the frame origin under the water
status: Fixed in v0.0.32 (489e5d7): arrivals are standing spots on converted collision, never the frame origin; tests/test_arrival_spot.py, tests/aga_scene_test.c.
severity_reason: The teleport leaves the player at the frame origin under the water; a v0.0.32 blocker.

title: Dense Vivec canton regions exceed the 32,767 texture-mapping limit
status: Fixed in v0.0.32: face texinfo read unsigned with a bounds check, tools allow 65,535; tests/aga_face_texinfo_test.c, tests/test_surface_grid.py.
severity_reason: 52 dense Vivec regions stop with Texture mapping budget exceeded.

title: Door overlay and interior section tools are outside the builder; their use in v0.0.31 is unverified
status: Closed 8 October 2026: neither tool output is in v0.0.31 (no section files or appended maps; no original exterior entrance doors in any world map)
where: Standalone door overlay and interior section tools
severity_reason: Closed: neither tool output is in v0.0.31; no builder step missing.

title: Pool workers started from tests import tools/mwad.py instead of the mwad package
status: Fixed in v0.0.35: pool workers put src/ first
where: pool workers and test import path (tools/mwad.py vs src/mwad)
severity_reason: A test worker can import different code from the parent, which could hide regressions.

title: A builder error message shows mojibake
status: Closed: duplicate of BUILD-MOJIBAKE-32 (same double-encoded dash in the tools/build.py --name message), registered separately by the stair work before both lines were merged on v0.0.33-dev
severity_reason: One builder error message shows garbled characters instead of a dash.
